title: appointments.appointments.bulk_create
description: A batch is THE SAME customer booking N slots (a five-session pass, a course): one customer, one service, one professional, N times. Since appointments#54 the three links live at the TOP level, which is the only shape `reads.params` can filter by (`payload.<field>`), so this command declares the same authoritative reads as `create` and inherits its whole fail-closed behaviour: the snapshot (customer name/phone/email, service name/price/duration, professional name) is frozen by the handler from those rows and an id that does not resolve refuses the WHOLE batch. A batch with a different customer per row is not a command any more: those are N `create`.

appointments.description: The slots of the batch. Each entry carries ONLY its own time; who, what and how much are the top-level links.

duration_minutes.description: Optional. When omitted, the professional's override, else the service's catalogue duration, else the module default applies.
